# Ziyad Tber

> Portfolio of Ziyad Tber, a software engineer in Marrakech, Morocco.

Ziyad works across frontend engineering, accessibility, performance, technical SEO, and CMS-driven platforms.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://ziyadtber.netlify.app/): Profile, skills, and selected work.
- [Projects](https://ziyadtber.netlify.app/works): Main and additional engineering projects.
- [Nexus Inclusion](https://ziyadtber.netlify.app/works/nexus-inclusion): Professional accessibility, technical SEO, frontend, and CMS work.
- [Tamazight MultiLingo](https://ziyadtber.netlify.app/works/tamazight-multilingo): AI-powered multilingual translation project.
- [Sophia](https://ziyadtber.netlify.app/works/sophia): Philosophy reading companion in active MVP development.
- [DiffShow](https://ziyadtber.netlify.app/works/diffshow): Open-source Git change-reporting CLI.
